_comment: Hand-written store release notes for 10.4.0, in both listing languages. tool/gen_changelog.py prefers this file over anything it can derive from the commits, then runs it through the same per-store platform gate as every other source — so keep every line free of operating-system, device and store names. One line per bullet; the leading bullet character is added when the note is written. Keep it short: the Play note is capped at 480 characters including the bullets.
en:
Organisations can turn on extended time tracking with timer, focus mode, timesheets, approvals and reports
With absences turned on, request leave, report sick days and see your team's absences at a glance
Start projects from templates, with deadlines that count from a date you pick
Choose when notifications reach you: always, or only on your days and hours
Tidier settings: longer explanations now wait behind an info button
Several smaller fixes and refinements
de:
Die erweiterte Zeiterfassung lässt sich einschalten: Timer, Fokusmodus, Stundenzettel, Freigaben, Berichte
Mit Abwesenheiten Urlaub beantragen, Krankheit melden und das Team im Blick behalten
Projekte aus Vorlagen anlegen, mit Fristen ab einem gewählten Datum
Benachrichtigungen kommen immer oder nur an deinen Tagen und Uhrzeiten
Aufgeräumte Einstellungen: lange Erklärungen stecken hinter einem Info-Knopf
Mehrere kleinere Korrekturen und Verbesserungen
